descriere_scurta: IF2 PZD sampling time
descriere: Sets the sampling time for the cyclic interface 2 (IF2).

descriere_scurta: CAN PDO mapping configuration
descriere: Selector switch for the PDO mapping. Sets the mapping for download or in the online mode after acknowledging with p8741.

descriere_scurta: CAN mapped 16-bit receive objects
descriere: Displays the mapped 16-bit receive CANopen objects in the process data buffer.

descriere_scurta: CAN status word
descriere: Displays the CANopen status word.

descriere_scurta: CAN status word bit 14
descriere: Binector input for CANopen status word bit 14.

descriere_scurta: CAN status word bit 15
descriere: Binector input for CANopen status word bit 15.

descriere_scurta: IF2 PZD4 receive bit-serial
descriere: Binector output for bit-serial interconnection of PZD4 (normally control word 2) received via interface 2.

descriere_scurta: CAN Target Velocity
descriere: Access to the CANopen object target velocity using the SDO transfer. The value is displayed in increments/second as standard.

descriere_scurta: CBE20 firmware selection
descriere: Selects the firmware version for the PROFINET COMM BOARD CBE20.

descriere_scurta: SINAMICS Link address
COMM BOARD monitoring time
descriere: Sets the monitoring time to monitor the process data received via COMM BOARD. If no process data is received within this time, an appropriate message is output.

descriere_scurta: COMM BOARD start configuration
PROFIdrive PZD state
descriere: Displays the PROFIdrive PZD state.

descriere_scurta: IF2 PZD1 receive bit-serial
descriere: Binector output for bit-serial interconnection of PZD1 (normally control word 1) received via interface 2.

descriere_scurta: IF2 PZD send double word
descriere: Selects the PZD (actual values) to be sent via interface 2 in the double word format. Index: [0] = PZD 1 + 2 [1] = PZD 2 + 3 [2] = PZD 3 + 4 [3] = PZD 4 + 5 [4] = PZD 5 + 6 [5] = PZD 6 + 7 [6] = PZD 7 + 8 [7] = PZD 8 + 9 [8] = PZD 9 + 10 [9] = PZD 10 + 11 [10] = PZD 11 + 12

descriere_scurta: IF2 PZD receive word
descriere: Connector output for interconnecting the PZD (setpoints) received via interface 2 in the word format. Index: [0] = PZD 1 [1] = PZD 2 [2] = PZD 3 [3] = PZD 4

descriere_scurta: IF2 PZD send word
descriere: Selects the PZD (actual values) to be sent via interface 2 in the word format. Index: [0] = PZD 1 [1] = PZD 2 [2] = PZD 3 [3] = PZD 4 [4] = PZD 5 [5] = PZD 6 [6] = PZD 7 [7] = PZD 8 [8] = PZD 9 [9] = PZD 10 [10] = PZD 11 [11] = PZD 12

descriere_scurta: SINAMICS Link address receive PZD
SINAMICS Link receive telegram word PZD
IF2 send binector-connector converter status word
descriere: Connector output to interconnect the status words to a PZD send word. Index: [0] = Status word 1 [1] = Status word 2 [2] = Free status word 3 [3] = Free status word 4 [4] = Free status word 5

descriere_scurta: IF2 invert binector-connector converter status word
descriere: Setting to invert the individual binector inputs of the binector connector converter. Index: [0] = Status word 1 [1] = Status word 2 [2] = Free status word 3 [3] = Free status word 4 [4] = Free status word 5

descriere_scurta: IF2 connector-binector converter signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the connector-binector converter. A PZD receive word can be selected as signal source. The signals are available to be serially passed-on (intercon- nection).

descriere_scurta: IE Name of Station active
descriere: This parameter defines the station name of the onboard Ethernet interface.

descriere_scurta: IE Name of Station
descriere: Sets the station name for the Industrial Ethernet interface (X127) on the Control Unit. The active station name is displayed in r8910.

descriere_scurta: IE Interface configuration
descriere: Setting to control the configuration of the Industrial Ethernet interface (X127) on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: CBE20 DHCP Mode
descriere: Sets the DHCP mode for the Communication Board Ethernet 20 (CBE20).

descriere_scurta: CBE20 interface configuration
descriere: Sets the configuration control for the Communication Board Ethernet 20 (CBE20).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion function specification (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the function specification for Safety Integrated.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion function configuration MM
descriere: Function configuration for Safe Motion Monitoring

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing cycle clock (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the clock cycle time of the actual value sensing for safe motion monitoring. Setting criteria if the motion monitoring functions are executed with an encoder. - A slower clock cycle time reduces the maximum permissible velocity - however, it ensures a lower load of the Con- trol Unit for safe actual value sensing. - The maximum permissible velocity which, when exceeded, can mean that errors occur during safe actual value sensing, is displayed in r9730. - The isochronous PROFIBUS clock cycle is used as a clock cycle time for actual value sensing with a setting of 0 ms; the setting is 1 ms if isochronous operation is not being used. Setting criteria if the motion monitoring functions are executed without an encoder: - The actual value sensing clock cycle must be set to the same value as the current controller clock cycle (p115).

descriere_scurta: SI enable, functions integrated in the drive (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the enable signals for safety functions on the Motor Module that are integrated in the drive. Not all of the settings listed below will be permissible, depending on the Control Unit and Motor Module or Power Module being used: - p9801 = 0: Safety functions integrated in the drive disabled. - p9801 = 1: STO/SS1 enabled via terminals. Permissible if r9871.0 = 1. - p9801 = 4: Motion monitoring functions integrated in the drive enabled via Terminal Module 54F (TM54F)

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder configuration, safety functions (Motor Module) /
descriere: Sets the configuration for the encoder and position actual value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion linear scale grid division (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the grid division for a linear encoder. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion fine resolution G1_XIST1 (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the fine resolution for G1_XIST1 in bits. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion spindle pitch (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the gear ratio between the encoder and load in mm/revolution for a linear axis with rotary encoder. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion gearbox encoder (motor)/load numerator (Motor Module) /
descriere: Sets the numerator for the gearbox between the encoder (or motor in the case of encoderless monitoring functions) and the load. It is not possible to change over the gearbox stages. Gearbox stage 0 is always active. Index: [0] = Gearbox 1 [1] = Gearbox 2 [2] = Gearbox 3 [3] = Gearbox 4 [4] = Gearbox 5 [5] = Gearbox 6 [6] = Gearbox 7 [7] = Gearbox 8

descriere_scurta: SI Motion redundant coarse pos. value fine resolution bits (MM)
descriere: Sets the number of valid bits for the fine resolution of the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion redundant coarse pos. value relevant bits (MM)
descriere: Sets the number of relevant bits for the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder assignment (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the number of the encoder that the Motor Module uses for safe motion monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion Sensor Module Node Identifier second channel
descriere: Displays the Node Identifier of the Sensor Module that the second channel uses for the motion monitoring func- tions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion Gx_XIST1 Safe most significant bit (MM)
descriere: Sets the bit number for the safe most significant bit (MSB) of the Gx_XIST1 coarse position. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion standstill tolerance (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS (SG) limit values (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the limit values for the function "Safely-Limited Speed" (SLS). Index: [0] = Limit value SLS1 [1] = Limit value SLS2 [2] = Limit value SLS3 [3] = Limit value SLP4

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLP (SE) stop response (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the stop response for the function "Safely-Limited Position" (SLP).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SCA (SN) plus cam position (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the minus cam position for the function "Safe Cam" (SCA). Index: [0] = Cam position SCA1 (SN1) [1] = Cam position SCA2 (SN2) [2] = Cam position SCA3 (SN3) [3] = Cam position SCA4 (SN4) [4] = Cam position SCA5 (SN5) [5] = Cam position SCA6 (SN6) [6] = Cam position SCA7 (SN7) [7] = Cam position SCA8 (SN8) [8] = Cam position SCA9 (SN9) [9] = Cam position SCA10 (SN10) [10] = Cam position SCA11 (SN11) [11] = Cam position SCA12 (SN12) [12] = Cam position SCA13 (SN13) [13] = Cam position SCA14 (SN14) [14] = Cam position SCA15 (SN15) [15] = Cam position SCA16 (SN16) [16] = Cam position SCA17 (SN17) [17] = Cam position SCA18 (SN18) [18] = Cam position SCA19 (SN19) [19] = Cam position SCA20 (SN20) [20] = Cam position SCA21 (SN21) [21] = Cam position SCA22 (SN22) [22] = Cam position SCA23 (SN23) [23] = Cam position SCA24 (SN24) [24] = Cam position SCA25 (SN25) [25] = Cam position SCA26 (SN26) [26] = Cam position SCA27 (SN27) [27] = Cam position SCA28 (SN28) [28] = Cam position SCA29 (SN29) [29] = Cam position SCA30 (SN30)

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SCA (SN) plus cam position (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the plus cam position for the function "Safe Cam" (SCA). Index: [0] = Cam position SCA1 (SN1) [1] = Cam position SCA2 (SN2) [2] = Cam position SCA3 (SN3) [3] = Cam position SCA4 (SN4) [4] = Cam position SCA5 (SN5) [5] = Cam position SCA6 (SN6) [6] = Cam position SCA7 (SN7) [7] = Cam position SCA8 (SN8) [8] = Cam position SCA9 (SN9) [9] = Cam position SCA10 (SN10) [10] = Cam position SCA11 (SN11) [11] = Cam position SCA12 (SN12) [12] = Cam position SCA13 (SN13) [13] = Cam position SCA14 (SN14) [14] = Cam position SCA15 (SN15) [15] = Cam position SCA16 (SN16) [16] = Cam position SCA17 (SN17) [17] = Cam position SCA18 (SN18) [18] = Cam position SCA19 (SN19) [19] = Cam position SCA20 (SN20) [20] = Cam position SCA21 (SN21) [21] = Cam position SCA22 (SN22) [22] = Cam position SCA23 (SN23) [23] = Cam position SCA24 (SN24) [24] = Cam position SCA25 (SN25) [25] = Cam position SCA26 (SN26) [26] = Cam position SCA27 (SN27) [27] = Cam position SCA28 (SN28) [28] = Cam position SCA29 (SN29) [29] = Cam position SCA30 (SN30)

descriere_scurta: SI Motion gearbox encoder (motor)/load denom (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the denominator for the gearbox between the encoder (or motor in the case of encoderless monitoring func- tions) and the load. It is not possible to change over the gearbox stages. Gearbox stage 0 is always active. Index: [0] = Gearbox 1 [1] = Gearbox 2 [2] = Gearbox 3 [3] = Gearbox 4 [4] = Gearbox 5 [5] = Gearbox 6 [6] = Gearbox 7 [7] = Gearbox 8

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act val comparison tol (crosswise) (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the cross-check of the actual position between the two monitoring channels. For encoderless motion monitoring functions, the tolerance must be set to a higher value (12 degrees rotary and 1 mm linear).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act val comparison tol (crosswise) (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the cross-check of the actual position between the two monitoring channels. For encoderless motion monitoring functions, the tolerance must be set to a higher value (12 degrees rotary and 1 mm linear).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM (SGA n < nx) velocity limit (CU)
descriere: Sets the velocity limit for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx). When this limit value is undershot, the signal "SSM feedback signal active" (SGA n < n_x) is set. If a value of 0 is entered in p9368/p9568, the value of parameter p9346/p9546 also applies for the safe acceleration monitor SBR.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM filter time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the filter time for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM velocity limit (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity limit for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx). When this limit value is undershot, the signal "SSM feedback signal active" is set. If a value of 0 is entered in p9368/p9568, the value of parameter p9346/p9546 applies also for the safe acceleration monitor SBR.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM velocity hysteresis (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity hysteresis for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SBR actual velocity tolerance (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance for the "Safe Acceleration Monitor".

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SBR actual velocity tolerance (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance for the "Safe Acceleration Monitor".

descriere_scurta: SI Motion slip velocity tolerance (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance that is used for a 2-encoder system in cross-check between the Control Unit and the Motor Module.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS (SG) changeover delay time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the SLS changeover or for the changeover from SLS to SOS for the function "Safely-Limited Speed" (SLS). When transitioning from a higher to a lower safely-limited velocity/speed stage or to the safe operating stop (SOS), within this delay time, the "old" velocity stage remains active. Even if SLS or SOS is activated from non safety-related operation, then this delay is still applied.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP C to SOS (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP C to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP D to SOS (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP D to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP E to SOS (SBH) (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP E to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP F to STOP B (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP F to STOP B.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression delay time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the safe pulse suppression after STOP B / SS1. In the case of encoderless motion monitoring functions (p9506/p9306 = 1), the parameter has no effect.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression test time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the time after which the pulses must have been suppressed when initiating the test stop.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test mode time limit (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the maximum time for the acceptance test mode. If the acceptance test mode takes longer than the selected time limit, then the mode is automatically terminated.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression shutdown velocity (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the shutdown velocity for pulse suppression. Below this velocity "standstill" is assumed and for STOP B / SS1, the pulses are suppressed (by changing to STOP A). In the case of encoderless motion monitoring functions, the parameter must be > 0 (recommended value: 10).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLP (SE) lower limit values (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the lower limit for the function "Safely-Limited Position" (SLP). Index: [0] = Limit value SLP1 (SE1) [1] = Limit value SLP2 (SE2)

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SBR velocity limit (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity limit for the "SBR" function. SBR is deactivated once the set velocity limit has been undershot.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test mode (Motor Module)
descriere: Setting to select and deselect the acceptance test mode.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test status (Motor Module)
descriere: Displays the status of the acceptance test mode.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion diagnostics position action value load side
descriere: Displays the actual load-side actual values of both monitoring channels and their difference. Index: [0] = Load-side actual value on the Control Unit [1] = Load-side actual value on the second channel [2] = Load-side actual value difference Control Unit - second channel [3] = Load-side max. actual value difference CU - 2nd channel

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression delay bus failure (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the delay time after which the pulses are safely suppressed after a bus failure.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp monitoring time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the monitoring time to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9581 (reference value) and p9583 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp reference value (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the reference value to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9581 (reference value) and p9583 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp delay time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the delay time for monitoring the brake ramp. Monitoring of the brake ramp starts once the delay time has elapsed.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act val sensing encoderless filter time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the filter time for smoothing the actual value with encoderless actual value sensing.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion voltage tolerance acceleration (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the voltage tolerance for suppressing acceleration peaks. Increasing this percentage value means that voltage peaks will need to have a higher amplitude during acceleration procedures if they are not to affect actual value sensing. - The value must be increased if C30711 has occurred with message value 1042. - The value must be decreased if acceleration procedures have led to an excessive safety actual velocity.

descriere_scurta: SI version (Sensor Module)
descriere: Displays the Safety Integrated version on the Sensor Module. Index: [0] = Safety Version (major release) [1] = Safety Version (minor release) [2] = Safety Version (baselevel or patch)

descriere_scurta: PS file parameter number parameter not transferred
descriere: Displays the parameters that were not able to be transferred when reading the parameter back-up files (PS files) from the non-volatile memory (e.g. memory card).

descriere_scurta: Number of BICO interconnections
descriere: Displays the number of BICO interconnections (signal sinks). The selected BICO interconnections should be entered into r9482[0...59] and r9483[0...59].

descriere_scurta: BICO interconnections BI/CI parameters
descriere: Displays the signal sinks (binector/connector inputs, BI/CI parameters). The number of BICO interconnections is displayed in r9481.

descriere_scurta: BICO interconnections search signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source (BO/CO parameter, BICO coded) to search in the signal sinks. The question is answered: How often is a connection made to a signal source in the drive object and from which index are these interconnec- tions saved (r9482[0...59], r9483[0...59])?

descriere_scurta: BICO interconnections signal source search first index
descriere: Displays the first index of the signal source being searched for. The signal source to be searched is set in p9484 (BICO-coded). The search result is contained in r9482[0...59] and r9483[0...59] and is specified by the count (r9485) and the first index (r9486).

descriere_scurta: Number of BICO interconnections to other drives
descriere: Displays the number of signal sources from this drive to other drives/drive objects (Binector Output/Connector Out- put, BO/CO).

descriere_scurta: BICO number of interconnections to deactivated drive objects
descriere: Displays the number of signal sinks of this drive object to other drives/drive objects that are no longer opera- tional/deactivated (Binector Input/Connector Input, BI/CI).

descriere_scurta: BICO BI/CI parameters to deactivated drive objects
descriere: List of the BI/CI parameters that represent a connection to non-operational/deactivated drive objects.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion monitoring clock cycle (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the monitoring clock cycle for safe motion monitoring.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion axis type (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the axis type (linear axis or rotary axis/spindle).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SCA (SN) enable (Control Unit)
descriere: Setting to enable the function "Safe Cam" (SCA).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion function specification (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the function specification for Safety Integrated.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion function specification (Control Unit)
descriere: Function configuration for Safe Motion Monitoring

descriere_scurta: SI Motion clock-cycle synchronous PROFIBUS master
descriere: Setting for the clock-cycle synchronous PROFIBUS master. The parameter must be set if the safety-relevant motion monitoring functions integrated in the drive are enabled and there is a clock-cycle synchronous PROFIBUS master. This is, for example, the case when using the following controls: - clock-cycle synchronous control for the motion control (e.g. SIMOTION). - clock-cycle synchronous PROFIsafe master (e.g. SIMATIC S7-400F).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder configuration safety functions (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the configuration for the motor encoder and position actual value.

descriere_scurta: Encoder inversion actual value
descriere: Setting to invert actual values.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder pulses per revolution (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the number of encoder pulses per revolution for rotary motor encoders.

descriere_scurta: Fine resolution Gx_XIST1 (in bits)
descriere: Sets the fine resolution in bits of the incremental position actual values.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion spindle pitch (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the gear ratio between the encoder and load in mm/revolution for a linear axis with rotary encoder.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion gearbox enc (motor)/load denominator (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the denominator for the gearbox between the encoder (or motor in the case of encoderless monitoring func- tions) and the load. It is not possible to change over the gearbox stages. Gearbox stage 0 is always active. Index: [0] = Gearbox 1 [1] = Gearbox 2 [2] = Gearbox 3 [3] = Gearbox 4 [4] = Gearbox 5 [5] = Gearbox 6 [6] = Gearbox 7 [7] = Gearbox 8

descriere_scurta: SI Motion Redundant coarse pos. value fine resolution bits (CU)
descriere: Sets the number of valid bits for the fine resolution of the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder assignment second channel
descriere: Sets the number of the encoder that the second channel (control, Motor Module) uses for safe motion monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion Gx_XIST1 Safe most significant bit (CU)
descriere: Sets the bit number for the safe most significant bit (MSB) of the Gx_XIST1 coarse position.
